notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q43244_lighthouse_of_alexandria.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/placekit.py) with AI assistance. A few metres down east of Fort Qaitbay, over some 140 by 100 m: the jumble of huge granite blocks of the fallen lighthouse, column shafts, capitals, obelisk fragments, sphinxes and broken colossal statues of Ptolemaic rulers. Some pieces have been raised (in 2025, 22 blocks of the doorway). The layout and the depth are approximate. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
